release_notes:
Auto Catalog reliability, masked API keys, per-API disconnect grace

- Auto Catalog: newly discovered supplier services now go straight to the
  supplier API (Recalculate). Publishing a discovered service is hardened so a
  database schema difference can no longer stop the whole catalog sync.
- New custom fields found during discovery are staged and promoted on publish.
- Terms & Conditions toggle is kept when editing a discovered draft.
- Supplier "Disconnect Grace (hours)" is now configurable per API.
- Admin API screen shows the saved API key masked instead of blank — leave it
  blank to keep the existing key.
- Cleaner sidebar "New" badge.
